adr_0710_kubernetes_admission_substrate.purpose: PROPOSED — NON-AUTHORITATIVE DESIGN CONTEXT, NOT A RULE. This entry exists so the proposal is discoverable, not so it can be acted on. Until ADR-0710 is Accepted the admission clauses of ADR-0183, ADR-0379 and ADR-0338 REMAIN IN FORCE and are NOT replaced; an agent implementing against this entry today is implementing unratified law. What it proposes: the Kubernetes admission substrate is the API SERVER rather than a policy webhook — ValidatingAdmissionPolicy + CEL for validation, Pod Security Admission for the pod-security baseline, MutatingAdmissionPolicy for mutation where the running version supports it, with Kyverno, Kubewarden and Gatekeeper/OPA as adapters only; resource generation as a controller concern, never admission; cross-resource data projected into a paramKind resource rather than fetched; image provenance moved to CI signing plus a CI-issued verified-digest allowlist that admission checks (digest pinning ALONE is explicitly not sufficient); and the owned Cedar-compatible + Zanzibar ReBAC PDP kept OUT of the admission path on shape and coupling grounds. It stays Proposed because clause D-8 (tenant isolation comes from topology, not policy) awaits WORKLOAD-boundary evidence — whether two tenants can share a node, hypervisor or physical host — which control-plane separation does not supply. ADR-0338's tier MODEL is unaffected under either outcome.
